"""Fixture: refusal reason dynamic-construction (hand)."""

from agent_workflows import artifact_meta


def _build_plan_text(extra_line: str) -> str:
    return (
        "# IPD: Dynamic Construction Plan\n\n"
        "- Id: dy1001\n"
        "- Status: approved\n" + extra_line
    )


def test_dynamic_construction_plan() -> None:
    text = _build_plan_text("")
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="ipd")
    assert st.id6 == "dy1001"
    assert st.status == "approved"
